references.purpose: character-specific authored turnaround; final pose art explicitly removes extra hip book on reference left profile

visualReview: All eight final source sheets and all eight packed atlas sheets inspected for broad middle-aged identity, complete shoes, cap, independently authored cardinal views and readable pose changes.
Only one chest-held notebook in both hands. All final poses omit the stray hip book visible in one direction of the earlier turnaround; back poses naturally occlude the chest book.

Down-run source was redrawn to separate two touching alpha components; left/right run sources were redrawn to restore clipped toe tips and add spacing. Full rejected source hashes and corrective prompts are retained.

Corrected run sheets were authored with more spacing and therefore lower original pixel density. Same first contact-pose measurement calibrates one factor for each whole sheet; no individual frame height is normalized.
Calibrated packed running and idle checked together; clothing, cap, face and body visual scale now agree.

Manifest previewBox is computed from down-idle. Up-idle includes 2px soft-alpha above its top; integration must use verified four-way effective previewBox [36,72,183,308]. No visible alpha>16 pixels are lost by the original box.

scope: 64 authored poses for complete eight-slot pineapple outfit only. Four directions each have eight run drawings and one drawing for each idle/start/stop/turn/rise/apex/fall/land; not multi-frame action transitions or authored independent clothing layers.
originals: Final native PNGs retained locally. Delivered lossless WebP masters decode to identical original RGBA including invisible RGB. Superseded originals are not required in the delivered asset package; their SHA256 and prompts remain in provenance.

operations: explicit cropped region extraction retaining own RGBA
pipeline.extractionDisclosure: Eight disconnected source alpha>16 silhouettes define ownership; other-pose pixels within overlapping bounding rectangles are excluded by nearest-silhouette assignment. Own RGBA pixels are retained exactly before resampling. Original PNG/WebP masters retain every source pixel.

sourceDensityCalibration.scope: Only three complete run correction sheets; each sheet uses one density factor across all eight authored poses. No pose-specific equal-height scaling.
